**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 19, ¶p0133).**

Section 19 is the only responsive clause. Although mutual, it is a **no-hire** rather than a non-solicit, it reaches **any employee** of the other party (not just personnel involved in the services), runs for the term plus one year, and contains **no** general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-outs — walk-away territory under NOSOLICIT.

Redline (fallback level, validated): a single surgical replacement converting the clause into a mutual non-solicit of personnel directly involved in the provision of services, for 12 months after that involvement ends, with express carve-outs for general advertisements/general solicitations and unsolicited approaches, and express confirmation that hiring is not prohibited. All six fallback elements are carried by that one operation; no unrelated text was touched.
